neighbours.label: The separator between items of an enumeration (the comma or 'and' after one listed item, or an item number), vs commas that separate clauses; very weak on short sentences

predictions: List commas in long enumerations reach about 0.05-0.1; clause commas under 0.02. Activations are tiny on short text, so the test will probably fail.
notes: Card: ',' x16 and digits x8 of the top 32, all list separators (a judge, an expert; boots, base layer; Italian, English, French). Probe on short lists was near the floor: kit list 0.072, languages 0.020, members 0.014, numbered colors 0.006; clause commas 0.006-0.009.
